title: Extend compile_latex façade to surface emitted f_ext kernel
objective: Expose the f_ext init kernel through compile_latex output (P2-1 façade extension) without breaking existing callers.

plan_assets.asset_description: Risk: keep current return shape default; add new f_ext_kernel field as optional

scope: Add optional f_ext_kernel field to the returned dataclass / dict
Preserve back-compat for callers not using Neumann BCs
No behavior change when no Neumann directive present
implementation_steps: Locate current compile_latex return type and downstream consumers
Wire boundary codegen output into the façade aggregator
Smoke test: directive-only Neumann LaTeX → f_ext_kernel populated
Smoke test: no Neumann directive → f_ext_kernel is None and existing fields unchanged
deliverables: Updated compile_latex return value including f_ext_kernel
Brief in-code note (not docstring; that is P3-1)
